article.story: RICHMOND, Va. -- — Dominick Stewart’s 32 points led Richmond over Bethune-Cookman 86-79 on Wednesday. Stewart added six rebounds for the Spiders (5-3). Jamie Kaiser Jr. shot 7 for 15, including 2 for 8 from beyond the arc to add 16 points. Aiden Argabright finished with 15 points. Mari Jordan led the Wildcats (0-6) in scoring, finishing with 26 points, nine rebounds and two steals. Daniel Rouzan added 15 points for Bethune-Cookman. Stewart scored 14 points in the first half and Richmond went into halftime trailing 41-34. Stewart’s 18-point second half helped Richmond finish off the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
